name: Stars Are Falling
source:
Year 2XXX

Eriu, an astronaut from Earth, is sent on a crucial mission to planet Mercury (space!) for its coveted metal resource, Ourobium.

There, she meets Iah, a Mercurian, who guides her around Mercury.

And thus, everything is set into motion.
A light story of stars, slimy blobs, and a sprinkle of loneliness.

[From [url=https://cometfall.itch.io/stars-are-falling]itch.io[/url]]
